mintAuthority.summary: dEURO has permissionless minter proposals with a proven 14-day application window and a 2% holding-period-weighted nDEPS minority veto. New or transferred shares carry no immediate votes. It nevertheless fails D30: existing zero-window hub/Position interest-loss settlement can mint a reserve shortfall without a new veto admission (V2/V4), and DEPSWrapper can asymmetrically reduce its own accumulated voting age at a qualified caller's request (V3). D30-R admits the currently unreachable insolvency restructure, but does not cover this wrapper override. Savings monetary-policy paths satisfy D30-S and remain reserve-bounded. Economically unbounded, unreconciled remains the fail-closed ordinary rung.

controls.label: dEURO minter registry and closed module census
controls.capDescription: The registry has no token-level economic ceiling; permissionless admission admits arbitrary-recipient mint code. Existing modules enforce their reviewed source/family/reserve constraints except the separately identified durable-interest reserve-shortfall path.
controls.evidence: Ethereum block 26117214 (0x17a158c02f6d95a7e3e54099f49ddc3ffba70b9909443b1d806e4964c8c28dc3), eth_getCode exactly matches verified dEURO runtime (10866 bytes; keccak256 0x0459afd840c25376c3c5991883bc81af8642bc044b4b4563b014e20f5a53b9cc). eth_call MIN_APPLICATION_PERIOD()=1209600, MIN_FEE()=1000e18, reserve()=0xc71104001a3ccda1bef1177d765831bd1bfe8ee6. suggestMinter 0xd1a15ff1 accepts arbitrary addresses after the fee and public delay; mint and mintWithReserve impose only minter authorization, not collateral. Complete eth_getLogs over 22088283..26117214 found 25 MinterApplied and one MinterDenied: 24 active modules, no pending applications. All module runtime bytecodes match verified source. The eight initial admissions had applicationPeriod=0 and fee=0, not a veto window. Bridges are source-transfer/immutable-limit gated; Savings and FrontendGateway clamp payouts to equity; PositionRoller flash mint is repaid in the same transaction; Position principal is collateral/family-limit gated. However existing hub/Position coverLoss paths mint a reserve shortfall including uncapped accrued interest, then burn principal and collect interest back to reserve. This is a zero-admission-delay non-veto unbounded durable-interest path, separately certified, failing V2/V4. initialize 0xf399e22e requires both supplies zero; eth_call totalSupply()=1259984883950306066870475 and Equity.totalSupply()=2519030651522408755046305278, and an initialize eth_call reverted at the pin. Closure is current-state, not a claim that an entirely extinguished system cannot reinitialize.

controls.label: nDEPS minority-veto governance (Equity)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26117214 (0x17a158c02f6d95a7e3e54099f49ddc3ffba70b9909443b1d806e4964c8c28dc3), eth_getCode exactly matches verified Equity source. votes(holder)=balanceOf(holder)*(uint64(block.timestamp<<20)-voteAnchor[holder]); _update adjusts recipient and total anchors so transferred/new shares add zero immediate votes. votesDelegated sums sorted, deduplicated, valid delegation support. checkQualified 0x352e3a83 requires votesDelegated*10000 >= 200*totalVotes. dEURO denyMinter 0x9b404da6 calls checkQualified during the application window. kamikaze 0x2295abea destroys target votes at an at-least-matching caller cost. restructureCapTable 0x820710af burns arbitrary holders' shares only when dEURO.equity()<1000e18 and the caller qualifies; eth_call equity()=63136024511895141755806, so D30-R admits this currently unreachable insolvency power. Ordinary redeem paths keep shares+1e18<totalSupply, and only restructure can wipe nDEPS supply to zero. However linked DEPSWrapper 0x103747924e74708139a9400e4ab4bea79fffa380.halveHoldingDuration(address[]) 0x8747842b calls nDEPS.checkQualified(caller,helpers), then nDEPS.transfer(address(this),totalSupply()) to halve wrapper-held voting age without caller sacrifice or an insolvency condition. This independent asymmetric override is not covered by D30-R; veto.override remains unknown and V3 fails closed. Equity invest/investFor transfers existing dEURO and mints only nDEPS; redeem/redeemExpected/redeemFrom burns nDEPS after 90-day average holding and transfers existing dEURO. No native Equity arbitrary-call, delegatecall, fallback, owner or upgrade path exists.

governedIssuance.votingPowerEvidence: Verified deployed Equity at Ethereum block 26117214 (0x17a158c02f6d95a7e3e54099f49ddc3ffba70b9909443b1d806e4964c8c28dc3), eth_getCode runtime matches verified source (12120 bytes; keccak256 0x4343d2134f84098eb8c5d41ea922a7b7e0b97055897ac06473bc668f0a3e62b0). votes(address) 0xd8bff5a5 = balanceOf(holder)*(_anchorTime()-voteAnchor[holder]); _anchorTime = uint64(block.timestamp<<20). _update invokes _adjustRecipientVoteAnchor and _adjustTotalVotes before changing balances: recipient anchor preserves existing votes (less rounding); transferred/new shares add zero immediate votes; sender loses amount*age. totalVotes() 0x0d15fd77 adds totalSupply*(time-totalVotesAnchorTime) to totalVotesAtAnchor. votesDelegated(address,address[]) 0x5895b773 sums age-weighted votes after sorted/deduplicated helper and delegation checks; delegateVoteTo 0x9823004f changes delegation only. holdingDuration 0xc9f72b67 and relativeVotes 0x84a7aa0c expose age and relative weight. This is holding-period-weighted, not plain live-balance voting; transferable shares do not transfer their accrued vote age.

veto.evidence: At Ethereum block 26117214 (0x17a158c02f6d95a7e3e54099f49ddc3ffba70b9909443b1d806e4964c8c28dc3), verified deployed dEURO denyMinter(address,address[],string) 0x9b404da6 checks block.timestamp <= minters[minter] then Equity.checkQualified(msg.sender,helpers) 0x352e3a83. Private constant QUORUM=200; qualification requires votesDelegated*10000 >= 200*totalVotes. kamikaze(address[],uint256) 0x2295abea is symmetric vote destruction. restructureCapTable(address[],address[]) 0x820710af requires equity()<1000e18 and qualification, then burns arbitrary holders' entire shares without caller sacrifice; pinned eth_call equity()=63136024511895141755806, so D30-R admits that currently unreachable insolvency path. But DEPSWrapper 0x103747924e74708139a9400e4ab4bea79fffa380.halveHoldingDuration(address[]) 0x8747842b calls nDEPS.checkQualified(caller,helpers), then nDEPS.transfer(address(this),totalSupply()), asymmetrically halving wrapper-held voting age without sacrificing caller votes and without insolvency gating. No owner ruling admits this independent override. unknown is deliberate fail-closed authoring; V3 fails despite proven holding-period weighting and 200-bps qualification.

monetaryPolicyPaths.evidence: Ethereum block 26117214 (0x17a158c02f6d95a7e3e54099f49ddc3ffba70b9909443b1d806e4964c8c28dc3), exact runtime-matched SavingsGateway and inherited Savings/Leadrate source: interest is saved balance times accrued rate ticks divided by 1000000 and 365 days, additionally clamped to dEURO.equity(). Rate storage and proposal argument are uint24, hard maximum 16777215 ppm. proposeChange checks Equity qualification, overwrites the pending rate and sets nextChange=block.timestamp+604800; any qualified minority may replace the proposal with the current rate and reset the clock. eth_call currentRatePPM=100000, nextRatePPM=0, nextChange=1786415591. D30-S conditions hold; this reserve-covered monetary-policy path is raiseable with bounded impairment, not an unbounded shortfall mint.

review.evidence: Ethereum block 26117214 (0x17a158c02f6d95a7e3e54099f49ddc3ffba70b9909443b1d806e4964c8c28dc3), eth_getCode source/runtime matches, eth_call and eth_getLogs over 22088283..26117214 close the census: 25 MinterApplied, one MinterDenied, 24 active modules, no pending applications; 103 registered positions from both hubs, 37 full originals and 66 fixed-target clones. MIN_APPLICATION_PERIOD()=1209600 and MIN_FEE()=1000e18; eight initializer admissions had period/fee zero. Bridges enforce source transfers, immutable limits and horizons; Savings and FrontendGateway payouts are clamped to equity; roller flash mints are repaid atomically. Position principal is collateral/family-limit gated, but its fixed uint24 annual rate is not automatically reset by minority counter-proposals and interest accrues beyond expiration. Hub/Position coverLoss pays reserve shortfall by minting, burns principal and collects interest back to reserve, leaving a reachable unbounded durable-interest path at delay zero. D30-S does not admit that path; the separately listed Savings paths do meet formula/rate-cap/minority-replaceable-delay conditions. Equity votes are balance times holding duration with transfer-anchor adjustment, not plain live-balance voting. denyMinter 0x9b404da6 uses 200-bps checkQualified 0x352e3a83. kamikaze is symmetric; restructureCapTable 0x820710af is gated by equity<1000e18, while pinned equity()=63136024511895141755806, so D30-R would admit that isolated override. Ordinary redemptions retain at least one nDEPS share; only restructure can zero the share supply. However DEPSWrapper.halveHoldingDuration 0x8747842b lets a qualified minority halve the wrapper's age-weighted votes without its own sacrifice or insolvency gating; unknown override remains necessary. initialize requires both supplies zero; token supply=1259984883950306066870475 and nDEPS supply=2519030651522408755046305278; a pinned initialize eth_call reverted. V1 passes complete fresh scopes and closed census; V2 fails existing durable-interest issuance delay zero; V3 fails the independent ungated wrapper override; V4 fails the non-veto initial interest-shortfall path; V5 passes active veto selectors targeting the registry; V6 passes closed events and capacity reads; V7 passes the two reviewed Savings monetary-policy paths. Ordinary unbounded-unreconciled posture remains; no affirmative-governed fallback, bounded-economic reclassification or threshold waiver is claimed.
